title: Cadet Engineer
content_text:
Parkes Shire Council Cadet Engineer (PSC2222600), ApplyNow, verified 5 Oct 2026 AEST.
Seeking a Cadet Engineer while completing a Civil Engineering degree. Assist with engineering design, estimating and contract administration; support infrastructure projects across roads and civil assets; traffic impacts, Roads Act / Heavy Vehicle applications, NHVR permits.
Essential: HSC and eligibility for entry to an engineering degree via recognised distance education; NSW Drivers Licence; SafeWork NSW White Card. Highly valued: currently undertaking tertiary studies in engineering/surveying; GIS and/or AutoCAD.
CAT Program 2026: cadetship with training costs paid. Salary T4-T8 $860-$1169/week. LinkedIn post 12 Sep 2026: applications close 11 October 2026 for Cadet Engineer. Council contact email on page: Council@parkes.nsw.gov.au (general access/correction notice, not an application inbox).
Apply via ApplyNow portal.
apply_instructions: Apply online at https://parkes.applynow.net.au/jobs/PSC2222600-cadet-engineer (closing 11 October 2026 per Council LinkedIn).
